changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql:
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'RuleImplementation') BEGIN exec sp_rename 'dbo.RuleImplementation', 'RuleImplementation_bak'; END
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_RuleResult_RuleImplementation' and object_name(parent_object_id) in ('RuleResult')) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[RuleResult] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_RuleResult_RuleImplementation]; END
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_RuleResult_RuleImplementation' and object_name(parent_object_id) in ('RuleResult_bak')) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[RuleResult_bak] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_RuleResult_RuleImplementation]; END
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'RuleImplementation_bak') BEGIN DROP TABLE dbo.RuleImplementation_bak END
changeSet.rollback:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'RuleImplementation_bak') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[RuleImplementation_bak]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [RuleID] [int] NOT NULL, [SourceID] [varchar](250) NULL, [SourceUri] [varchar](2500) NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](250) NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_RuleImplementation] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_RuleImplementation_Rule') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[RuleImplementation_bak] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_RuleImplementation_Rule] FOREIGN KEY([RuleID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Rule] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[RuleImplementation_bak] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_RuleImplementation_Rule] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_RuleResult_RuleImplementation') BEGIN IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'RuleResult_bak') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[RuleResult_bak] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_RuleResult_RuleImplementation] FOREIGN KEY([RuleImplementationID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[RuleImplementation_bak] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[RuleResult_bak] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_RuleResult_RuleImplementation] END END
